title: SARUAV convolutional-network detector locates an unconscious 65-year-old in tall grass during a Bieszczady Mountain Rescue search
summary: 29 June 2021: SARUAV CNN flagged a 65-year-old man unconscious in tall grass after 24+ h; GOPR Bieszczady retrieved him alive
account: On Monday 28 June 2021 at about 4 pm a 65-year-old man with Alzheimer's disease, who had suffered a stroke the previous day, left his home in Cergowa, south-east Poland; police and tracking dogs did not find him after a storm. On Tuesday 29 June the Bieszczady Mountain Rescue Service (GOPR Bieszczady) flew four drone flights and ran SARUAV, software from University of Wrocław researchers that uses convolutional neural networks to find people in nadir aerial images, on 782 images. After 4 h 31 min of analysis the system detected him and returned his coordinates; he was lying unconscious in grass over two meters tall after more than 24 hours outdoors. GOPR rescuers carried him out and handed him to the ambulance service. No cited source gives the day of the find outright; 29 June follows from the 28 June 4 pm departure and from the GOPR communique quoted by Świat Dronów, which opens “Od wczoraj – 28 czerwca” (“since yesterday, 28 June”) and says that the program flagged him after almost 24 hours.
purpose: Built to detect people automatically in drone imagery for search and rescue; this benefit is that purpose.
system: SARUAV (Search and Rescue with Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) human detection software
model_version: SARUAV, run on images from DJI Matrice 300 drones
developer: SARUAV Ltd. / University of Wrocław (team of Tomasz Niedzielski)

ratings.reason: A 65-year-old man with Alzheimer's and a stroke the previous day, unconscious in two-meter grass after more than 24 hours outdoors, was found and handed to the ambulance service alive.
GOPR Bieszczady closed a search that police, dogs and ground teams had not resolved, in what it called the first such find in Poland.

ai_role.statement: The CNN detector returned the man's coordinates after police and tracking dogs had failed; rescuers then retrieved him. Three of the five authors of the case report work for SARUAV Ltd., so the independent confirmation is the GOPR Bieszczady account quoted in the Polish press.

headline: SARUAV finds an unconscious 65-year-old alive in tall grass
metric: After 4 h 31 min of analysis the system detected him and returned his coordinates

comparator.against: the ground search by police officers and rescuers with tracking dogs, which had failed
comparator.before: Psy zgubiły trop (the dogs lost the scent); police and rescuers could not find him
comparator.after: Po prawie 24 godzinach od zginięcia program wskazał potencjalnego poszukiwanego (after almost 24 hours the program indicated the probable missing person)
comparator.quote: Burza, która przeszła nad terenem gdzie zgubił się chory 65-letni mężczyzna, utrudniła poszukiwania. Psy zgubiły trop. Pomogła nowoczesna technologia i to w ostatniej chwili, bo mężczyzna leżał w ponad dwumetrowych zaroślach bez ruchu.

revisions.change: Record drafted from the cited sources.

Added to the account that the 29 June date is derived from the 28 June departure and the GOPR communique rather than stated outright in any source, and dated the Świat Dronów report 30 June 2021 from its page metadata; the August 2024 echo keeps its disclosed first-of-month placeholder because dates must be full ISO days.
Benefit type set to Improved Physical Health under Trustible's full taxonomy of 23 types; it was Improved Organizational Efficiency among the six first used.
Added what the benefit is measured against, the model version from the cited sources.
Country of the developer and the deployer added from the organization's own site or a registry.

claim_basis: Three independent news reports, the makers' case report and the makers' press release are on file. There is no independent study or report and no finding by a regulator or court.
